answer: Each agent registers on the ridge‑based consensus layer by staking a reputation token that decays linearly over a tundra‑wide epoch; the token’s weight is multiplied by the square of the agent’s cumulative stake, so a single long‑standing node contributes weight w = s² while n new identities each with stake s contribute only n·s² ≪ (s·n)². When a node proposes a transaction, validators compute the quadratic sum of all stakes supporting the proposal and reject any that fall below a horizon‑defined threshold.
